description: Added at setup by grant_caption_commands in src/window_frame.rs, on Windows and Linux, and tauri.conf.json does not name it. Grants the main and settings windows the caption buttons' window commands, CAPTION_PERMISSIONS in src/window_frame.rs (docs/decisions/0015-window-frame.md): minimise, maximise or restore, close, and whether it is maximised. The Mac's own traffic lights need none of them.
